findings.current:
“Can we open the door for a second?”

“What?”

“I said, can we open the plane door?”
findings.defect: The draft changes Taekyung’s request to open the door himself into a collective action.
findings.rationale: The omitted Korean subject is resolved by the surrounding exchange and Taekyung’s later statement that he is opening it.
findings.replacement:
“Can I open the door for a second?”

“What?”

“I said, can I open the plane door?”
findings.source:
“잠깐만 문 열어도 돼요?”

“예?”

“비행기 문 좀 열어도 되냐고요.”

findings.current: And there were more than a dozen of them!
findings.defect: The draft changes an approximate count of around ten into a definite count exceeding twelve.
findings.rationale: 십여 마리 means roughly ten or a dozen, not more than twelve.
findings.replacement: And there were around a dozen of them!

findings.current: More than a dozen pairs of bright yellow eyes stared at one another.
findings.defect: The draft again turns an approximate count into a definite count exceeding twelve.
findings.rationale: 십여 쌍 indicates an approximate count around ten.
findings.replacement: Around a dozen pairs of bright yellow eyes stared at one another.
findings.source: 십여 쌍의 샛노란 눈동자들이 서로를 바라본다.

findings.current: More than a dozen pairs of wings began flapping desperately.
findings.defect: The draft again overstates the approximate number of wyverns.
findings.rationale: 십여 쌍 means approximately ten pairs, not necessarily more than twelve.
findings.replacement: Around a dozen pairs of wings began flapping desperately.
findings.source: 십여 쌍의 날개가 필사적으로 퍼덕이기 시작했다.

findings.current: “Come to think of it, I’ve heard about that Hunter. They say he’s such an incredible fighter that Chairman Xiao Yang personally requested him.”
findings.defect: The draft omits 동지, erasing the speaker’s conspicuously Communist political register and form of address.
findings.rationale: 주석 동지 explicitly combines the title Chairman with Comrade; even also preserves the force of 도.
findings.replacement: “Come to think of it, I’ve heard about that Hunter. They say he’s so formidable that even Comrade Chairman Xiao Yang made a special request for him.”
findings.source: “그, 그러고 보니 저 헌터님에 관해서 들은 적이 있어. 샤오 양 주석 동지께서도 특별히 요청할 만큼 대단한 실력자라던데.”

findings.current: How could a mere human dare to—
findings.defect: The draft omits the wyverns’ self-identification as descendants of the great dragons, losing the basis of their pride and disbelief.
findings.rationale: 위대한 드래곤의 후예 is an explicit characterization and hierarchy cue, not merely an unfinished generic objection.
findings.replacement: How could a mere human dare lay a hand on a descendant of the great dragons…
findings.source: 어떻게 인간 따위가 감히 위대한 드래곤의 후예를…….

findings.current: The nerve of him, insulting Koreans right in front of a proud son of Daehan—this kimchi man!
findings.defect: Daehan is left as an unestablished romanization, while “son of” is added and the sentence is awkwardly fragmented.
findings.rationale: 대한 refers to Korea here; the replacement preserves Taekyung’s mock-patriotic self-description without inventing a filial metaphor.
findings.replacement: The nerve of him, insulting Koreans right in front of a proud Korean kimchi man like me!
findings.source: 감히 자랑스러운 대한의 김치맨 앞에서 한국인을 비하하는 말을 하다니.

findings.current: Compared to the aura emitted by the Western Heaven Demon Lord, this was no more than a gentle spring breeze.
findings.defect: Aura obscures that 기파 denotes emitted waves of Murim qi rather than a passive surrounding presence.
findings.rationale: The source describes the physical qi waves he gave off, which are the direct mechanical comparison for the wind pressure.
findings.replacement: Compared to the waves of qi the Western Heaven Demon Lord had emitted, this was no more than a gentle spring breeze.
findings.source: 서천마군이 내뿜던 기파에 비교하면, 이 정도는 살랑거리는 봄바람이나 다름없었으니까.

findings.current: The flame-infused sword qi surrounding the spearhead burned through the air and cleaved the wind.
findings.defect: The draft calls the energy on a spearhead “sword qi,” although this occurrence is simply 강기 and does not specify a sword.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the concentrated Murim energy and its coating action without introducing the wrong weapon category.
findings.replacement: Fiery concentrated qi sheathed the spearhead, burning the air and cleaving the wind.
findings.source: 창날에 서린 화염의 강기가 공기를 태우고 바람을 가른다.

findings.current: “Don’t! You bingzi bastards![^1] Are you trying to kill us all?”
findings.defect: The Chinese slur 棒子 is incorrectly romanized as bingzi.
findings.rationale: The standard Mandarin romanization of 棒子 is bangzi; Korean 빵즈 reflects that pronunciation.
findings.replacement: “Don’t! You *bangzi* bastards![^1] Are you trying to kill us all?”
findings.source: “하지 말라고! 이 빵즈(棒子) 놈들아! 우릴 다 죽일 셈이냐!”

findings.current: [^1]: *Bingzi* (棒子) is a derogatory Chinese slur for Koreans.
findings.defect: The footnote repeats the incorrect romanization.
findings.rationale: The footnote must use the same corrected standard romanization as the dialogue.
findings.replacement: [^1]: *Bangzi* (棒子) is a derogatory Chinese slur for Koreans.

summary: The draft changes who proposes opening the door, overstates all three approximate wyvern counts, omits political and dragon-lineage register, and contains several terminology errors.
